source.author: verg
source.text: Stetimus tela aspera contra contulimusque manus: experto credite, quantus in clipeum assurgat, quo turbine torqueat hastam.
source.text_original: Stetimus tela aspera contra / contulimusque manus: experto credite, quantus / in clipeum assurgat, quo turbine torqueat hastam.
source.text_english: We stood our ground against the rough weapons and matched our hands with them: believe one who has tried it, how mighty a man rises against a shield, with what whirlwind he hurls his spear.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: si quid itaque in me potest esse consilii, si experto creditur, hoc primum moneo, hoc obtestor, ut sponsa Christi uinum fugiat pro ueneno.
reuse.text_original: si quid itaque in me potest esse consilii, si experto creditur, hoc primum moneo, hoc obtestor, ut sponsa Christi uinum fugiat pro ueneno.
reuse.text_english: Therefore, if there can be any judgment in me, if experience is believed, this I first advise, this I implore: that the bride of Christ should shun wine as poison.
